notes:
Lead profile: Seacliff ScribeWorks — small content automation startup building a knowledge assistant for B2B customers. Early-stage adoption intent: self-serve signups for hosted API; will likely convert to paid with usage growth.

Key asks from discovery: short list
- SOC2 Type II report or SOC2 timeline (they need either current report or expected attestation date)
- Full list of sub-processors (data flows) and whether any are outside EU/NA
- DPA draft with data residency & retention clauses; they want the ability to limit storage to US/EU for certain customers
- Clarify encryption: at-rest/in-transit, BYOK/KMS options on hosted API, key rotation cadence

Workload & SLOs (from SE call):
- Use cases: chat-based customer responses (support-agent) + embeddings for semantic search + automated A/B summary pipeline
- Expected initial volume: 50-300k tokens/month in POC; scale to 1-2M tokens/month after Q2 if POC metrics met
- Latency targets: p50 < 400ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens), p95 < 900ms acceptable; interactive chat UX priority
- Throughput: bursty; peak ~20 req/s during business hours; cost sensitivity moderate (startups budget-conscious)
- Model preferences: prefer open model variants (Llama2/Redwood-curated opens) for cost; will accept fallback to higher-capacity hosted models only if data controls documented

Security questionnaire notes (legal):
- Q: Are you SOC2 Type II? A: Redwood to provide recent SOC2 report or attestation date.
- Q: Sub-processors? A: Provide CSV list + region and purpose (analytics, logging, cloud infra). Legal will flag any non-EU/US processors.
- Q: Data retention & deletion processes? A: Need exact retention defaults and API for deletion.
- Q: Audit logs / access controls? A: Request sample of audit logs availability and retention window.

POC proposal (SE):
- 2-week POC on hosted_api with sandbox tenant + $2k in credits; test harness for embeddings and chat flows; target metrics: latency p50 < 400ms, average token cost below target range; quality judged by internal user eval set.
- Deliverables: POC report, cost projection for monthly usage, DPA draft for legal review.

Quotes & tenor: "We want a fast path to launch — self-serve if the legal bits are light. If legal drags, we'll re-evaluate other vendors." — CTO.

- SE (Aisha) to draft POC plan + add token burn estimates by 2026-03-14
